# Opportune

> Opportune is a 20-year global energy advisory firm providing consulting, investment banking, outsourcing, and specialized services to the energy sector.

Opportune combines deep energy sector expertise with comprehensive financial advisory, operational transformation, and technical services. The firm serves clients across upstream, midstream, and downstream energy markets, with particular strength in reserve engineering, M&A advisory, and regulatory compliance.

## Key Topics

- Investment Banking
- M&A Advisory
- Financial Reporting
- Energy Sector
- Restructuring
- Outsourcing
- Due Diligence
- Valuation Services
- Sustainability & ESG
- Reserve Engineering
- Business Transformation
- Litigation Support
- Tax Advisory
- Process Technology
- Capital Markets

## Core Capabilities

- [Investment Banking](https://opportune.com/capabilities/investment-banking): Investment banking and M&A advisory services
- [Transactional Advisory Services](https://opportune.com/capabilities/transactional-advisory-services): Transactional advisory and M&A due diligence services
- [Valuation](https://opportune.com/capabilities/valuation): Valuation and business appraisal services
- [Complex Financial Reporting](https://opportune.com/capabilities/complex-financial-reporting): Complex financial reporting and SEC compliance services
- [Tax Advisory](https://opportune.com/capabilities/tax): Tax planning and compliance advisory services
- [Outsourcing](https://opportune.com/capabilities/outsourcing): Business process outsourcing and accounting services

## Energy-Specific Services

- [Reserve Engineering & Geosciences](https://opportune.com/capabilities/reserve-engineering-geosciences): Reserve engineering and geoscience advisory services
- [Sustainability](https://opportune.com/capabilities/sustainability): Sustainability, ESG and energy transition advisory
- [Lender Advisory](https://opportune.com/capabilities/lender-advisory): Lender advisory and commodity lending services

## Operational & Strategic Services

- [Business Transformation](https://opportune.com/capabilities/business-transformation): Business transformation and operational improvement services
- [Process & Technology](https://opportune.com/capabilities/process-technology): Digital transformation and technology consulting services

## Disputes & Expert Services

- [Disputes & Litigations](https://opportune.com/capabilities/disputes-litigations): Disputes, litigation support and expert witness services
